task_title: Implement Don Paco THE BIG GOB

plan_review.notes: Alt A: general reusable compound hazard/public-geometry model; adopted in narrower form by explicitly adding shared authoritative projectile/slick state instead of a Don-Paco-only visual shim. Alt B: schedule via mob-ability runtime but hand travel/zones to unrelated projectile/surface subsystems; rejected because the issue requires renderer/AI/projectile/impact/slick occupancy to consume one committed five-path geometry contract. Review forced explicit decisions for authoritative post-resolution state, exact cooldown anchor semantics, cone/circle/slick AI consumption, wall semantics, five-path verification, and correcting the stale Don Paco status metadata.

rounds.notes: Round 1 found two high-confidence issues: (1) death-ordering defect in mobAbilitySystem — tickActiveProjectiles/tickActiveZones ran before caster validity checks, allowing onImpact to fire for dead casters; (2) zone-dodge vector preservation predicate only checked for telegraph cues but not slick-zone occupancy, allowing AI to walk through active slicks. Both fixed: pre-tick caster validation pass added; preserveMobAbilityDodge extended to include active-zone occupancy check.

No further concerns. Death-ordering fix and zone-dodge vector preservation confirmed correct. All cleanup paths (clear, death, despawn, disable, invalid target, final-travel-frame death) tested and passing. No Math.random(), no Phaser imports in core, no non-determinism risks.

Secondary model confirmed the two code-review findings and additionally flagged the missing ADR for the projectile-fan geometry contract spanning core/engine/AI/arena. ADR 0076 created covering projectile/zone ownership, cleanup ordering, death-ordering contract, zone-dodge preservation, and shared geometry consumers.
All concerns resolved. ADR 0076 accepted. Code fixes verified by targeted unit tests including final-travel-frame death regression test. No further concerns from any reviewer.
